SDL.doc: Core SDL3 GUI, input and software rendering, with explicit lifetimes.

members.name: window
members.doc: A window owned until `destroyWindow`; dependent renderers prevent release.

members.name: surface
members.doc: An owned software pixel surface.

members.name: renderer
members.doc: An owned renderer retaining its window or software surface.

members.name: texture
members.doc: An owned texture retaining its renderer.

members.name: rect
members.spec: type rect = {x : int, y : int, width : int, height : int}
members.doc: Integer coordinates and dimensions in native pixels.

members.name: frect
members.spec: type frect = {x : real, y : real, width : real, height : real}
members.doc: Floating point coordinates and dimensions in native pixels.

members.name: event
members.doc: Copied event values; text survives subsequent SDL operations.

members.name: Error
members.spec: exception Error of {function : string, message : string}
members.doc: Native failure; the error text is captured before cleanup.

members.name: Unsupported
members.doc: A request outside the declared portable core behavior.

members.name: Closed
members.doc: A closed resource or an operation before loading its native library.

members.name: Busy
members.doc: A release with live children, locks or borrowers.

members.name: load
members.doc:
`load paths` names SDL3 and its generated adapter library; call before initialization.

The generated target must match the runtime width and byte order.

members.name: unload
members.doc: `unload ()` closes a quiescent library after `quit` and all resources.

members.name: constant
members.doc: `constant name` looks up one generated SDL core integer constant.

members.name: setMainReady
members.doc: `setMainReady ()` declares that Rune owns application startup on the VM thread.

members.name: init
members.doc: `init flags` initializes SDL subsystems after declaring main readiness.

members.name: initSubSystem
members.doc: `initSubSystem flags` adds a reference to the named subsystems.

members.name: quitSubSystem
members.doc: `quitSubSystem flags` releases subsystem references after all owned resources close.

members.name: quit
members.doc: `quit ()` shuts down SDL and releases retained pushed-event text; live resources raise `Busy`.

members.name: getError
members.doc: `getError ()` copies the current SDL UTF-8 error text immediately.

members.name: clearError
members.doc: `clearError ()` clears the current SDL error text.

members.name: createWindow
members.spec:
val createWindow : {title : string, width : int, height : int,
                    flags : Word64.word} -> window
members.doc: `createWindow options` creates an owned window with a copied UTF-8 title.

members.name: destroyWindow
members.doc: `destroyWindow window` destroys a window after its renderers close.

members.name: getWindowID
members.doc: `getWindowID window` returns its nonzero SDL event identity.

members.name: setWindowTitle
members.doc: `setWindowTitle (window, title)` copies a UTF-8 title into SDL.

members.name: getWindowSize
members.spec: val getWindowSize : window -> {width : int, height : int}
members.doc: `getWindowSize window` returns both native output dimensions.

members.name: setWindowSize
members.spec: val setWindowSize : window * int * int -> unit
members.doc: `setWindowSize (window, width, height)` requests a size change; OS events remain asynchronous.

members.name: setWindowPosition
members.spec: val setWindowPosition : window * int * int -> unit
members.doc:
`setWindowPosition (window, x, y)` requests a supported native position.

`SDL_WINDOWPOS_UNDEFINED` lets SDL choose an axis. Compositors may reject
explicit positioning; native failure propagates rather than being ignored.

members.name: setHint
members.doc:
`setHint (name, value)` sets an SDL policy hint before initialization.

This support operation is selected for the Win32-over-SDL provider.

members.name: showWindow
members.doc: `showWindow window` requests that the native window become visible.

members.name: hideWindow
members.doc: `hideWindow window` requests that the native window become hidden.

members.name: pollEvent
members.doc: `pollEvent ()` copies one available event; `NONE` means no event was returned.

members.name: waitEvent
members.doc: `waitEvent ()` blocks for one event and copies its payload.

members.name: waitEventTimeout
members.doc: `waitEventTimeout milliseconds` waits up to the given duration; `NONE` preserves the native timeout-or-error result through raw access.

members.name: pushEvent
members.doc:
`pushEvent event` queues a supported event; input-state snapshots are unaffected.

Text storage is retained until consumption or `quit`; `Unknown` requires raw access.

members.name: getKeyboardState
members.doc: `getKeyboardState ()` copies the complete current SDL keyboard snapshot.

members.name: getMouseState
members.spec: val getMouseState : unit -> {buttons : Word32.word, x : real, y : real}
members.doc: `getMouseState ()` returns buttons and both native float output coordinates.

members.name: startTextInput
members.doc: `startTextInput window` enables UTF-8 text input events for that window.

members.name: stopTextInput
members.doc: `stopTextInput window` disables text input for that window.

members.name: createSurface
members.spec: val createSurface : {width : int, height : int, format : Word32.word} -> surface
members.doc: `createSurface options` allocates an owned, zero-initialized pixel surface.

members.name: destroySurface
members.doc: `destroySurface surface` releases it after software renderers and locks close.

members.name: lockSurface
members.doc: `lockSurface surface` acquires a counted pixel lock; balance it with `unlockSurface`.

members.name: unlockSurface
members.doc: `unlockSurface surface` releases one lock; an unmatched call raises `Busy`.

members.name: withSurfacePixels
members.spec:
val withSurfacePixels : surface ->
  ({bytes : Word8Array.array, pitch : int, width : int, height : int,
    format : Word32.word} -> 'a) -> 'a
members.doc:
`withSurfacePixels surface body` locks an uncompressed surface and supplies a copied byte array.

Writes copy back on every returning path, including exceptions, before unlocking. FourCC and compressed formats raise `Unsupported`.

members.name: fillSurfaceRect
members.spec: val fillSurfaceRect : surface * rect option * Word32.word -> unit
members.doc: `fillSurfaceRect (surface, rect, color)` fills a rectangle or the entire surface; color is encoded in its pixel format.

members.name: blitSurface
members.spec:
val blitSurface : {source : surface, sourceRect : rect option,
                   destination : surface, destinationRect : rect option} -> unit
members.doc: `blitSurface options` copies and clips between surfaces using optional integer rectangles.

members.name: createRenderer
members.spec: val createRenderer : window * string option -> renderer
members.doc: `createRenderer (window, driver)` creates a renderer retaining the window; `NONE` lets SDL choose a driver.

members.name: createSoftwareRenderer
members.doc: `createSoftwareRenderer surface` creates a renderer retaining the target surface.

members.name: destroyRenderer
members.doc: `destroyRenderer renderer` destroys it after its textures close.

members.name: setRenderDrawColor
members.spec: val setRenderDrawColor : renderer * {red : int, green : int, blue : int, alpha : int} -> unit
members.doc: `setRenderDrawColor (renderer, color)` sets channels from zero through 255; other values raise `Domain`.

members.name: renderClear
members.doc: `renderClear renderer` clears the render target with the current draw color.

members.name: renderPoint
members.spec: val renderPoint : renderer * real * real -> unit
members.doc: `renderPoint (renderer, x, y)` draws one floating point position.

members.name: renderLine
members.spec: val renderLine : renderer * real * real * real * real -> unit
members.doc: `renderLine (renderer, x1, y1, x2, y2)` draws a line in renderer coordinates.

members.name: renderRect
members.spec: val renderRect : renderer * frect option -> unit
members.doc: `renderRect (renderer, rect)` outlines the optional rectangle or complete target.

members.name: renderFillRect
members.spec: val renderFillRect : renderer * frect option -> unit
members.doc: `renderFillRect (renderer, rect)` fills the optional rectangle or complete target.

members.name: renderPresent
members.doc: `renderPresent renderer` presents accumulated drawing on the owning VM thread.

members.name: renderReadPixels
members.spec: val renderReadPixels : renderer * rect option -> surface
members.doc: `renderReadPixels (renderer, rect)` copies pixels into a new owned surface.

members.name: createTextureFromSurface
members.doc: `createTextureFromSurface (renderer, surface)` copies pixels into a texture retaining its renderer.

members.name: destroyTexture
members.doc: `destroyTexture texture` destroys the texture and releases its renderer dependency.

members.name: renderTexture
members.spec: val renderTexture : renderer * texture * frect option * frect option -> unit
members.doc: `renderTexture (renderer, texture, source, destination)` copies a texture using optional floating rectangles.

members.name: renderDebugText
members.spec: val renderDebugText : renderer * real * real * string -> unit
members.doc: `renderDebugText (renderer, x, y, text)` draws SDL debug text. SDL documents its built-in font as ASCII; UTF-8 is validated at the boundary.

members.name: hasClipboardText
members.doc: `hasClipboardText ()` reports whether SDL exposes clipboard text.

members.name: getClipboardText
members.doc: `getClipboardText ()` copies UTF-8 clipboard text and calls `SDL_free` before returning.

members.name: setClipboardText
members.doc: `setClipboardText text` copies UTF-8 text to the clipboard.

members.name: getTicks
members.doc: `getTicks ()` returns elapsed SDL milliseconds as an unsigned 64-bit value.

members.name: getTicksNS
members.doc: `getTicksNS ()` returns elapsed SDL nanoseconds as an unsigned 64-bit value.

members.name: getPerformanceCounter
members.doc: `getPerformanceCounter ()` returns the current unsigned high-resolution counter.

members.name: getPerformanceFrequency
members.doc: `getPerformanceFrequency ()` returns high-resolution counter ticks per second.

members.name: delay
members.doc: `delay milliseconds` requests a native delay; scheduling can extend it.

SDL_NATIVE_LAYOUT.doc: Generated target facts used by SDL's SML projection.

members.name: pointerBytes
members.doc: The selected native pointer width in bytes.

members.name: littleEndian
members.doc: Whether native scalar objects store the least significant byte first.

members.name: enumSigned
members.doc: Whether the target C ABI gives nonnegative enums a signed int type.

members.name: sizeOf
members.doc: `sizeOf name` returns a selected original C object's byte size.

members.name: offset
members.spec: val offset : string * string list -> int
members.doc: `offset (name, path)` returns a selected nested field's byte offset.

members.name: constant
members.doc: `constant name` returns a selected C integer constant, preserving its bits.

SDL_NATIVE_RAW.doc: The generated dynamic calls required by the core SDL projection.

members.name: session
members.doc: One explicitly loaded collection of libraries and prepare calls.

members.name: openSession
members.doc: `openSession {libraries}` loads the named native SDL and adapter files.

members.name: closeSession
members.doc: `closeSession session` closes an idle session after its resources close.

members.name: call
members.spec: val call : session -> string -> RuneForeign.argument list -> RuneForeign.result
members.doc: `call session name arguments` invokes one selected original or generated helper.

members.name: prepare
members.doc: `prepare session name` exposes the selected prepare call for guarded destruction.
